name: AffectGPT
authors_or_creators: Zheng Lian, Licai Sun, Haiyang Sun, Kang Chen, Zhuofan Wen, Hao Gu, Bin Liu, Jianhua Tao; Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA) and Tsinghua University
publication_venue: arXiv preprint (with extension under review / ICML 2024 workshop versions); EMER framework introduced in this preprint line
backbone: Large Language Model backbone (LLaMA / Vicuna family) coupled with multimodal encoders for video, audio, and text; visual encoder based on CLIP/ViT, audio encoder based on HuBERT/Whisper [uncertain]
accuracy_fer2013: Not reported - model is evaluated on multimodal emotion reasoning (EMER) rather than static FER benchmarks
accuracy_affectnet: Not reported - not the target evaluation benchmark [uncertain]
accuracy_rafdb: Not reported - not the target evaluation benchmark [uncertain]
pretrained_weights_available: partial - code and EMER dataset released via the official GitHub; full weights availability varies by version [uncertain]
hardware_requirements: Server-class GPU with >=24GB VRAM for 7B LLM inference; multi-GPU (A100) for training [uncertain]
loss_function: Autoregressive language-modeling cross-entropy loss for instruction tuning on EMER explanation data
training_data_used: EMER (Explainable Multimodal Emotion Reasoning) dataset built on MER2023 with manually annotated multimodal clues and natural-language emotion rationales; supplementary multimodal emotion datasets
pretraining_strategy: VLM-pretrain - leverages pretrained vision/audio encoders and an instruction-tuned LLM, then fine-tuned on EMER explanation data
pretraining_corpus: Underlying LLM pretraining corpus (LLaMA/Vicuna); CLIP/ViT image-text pretraining; HuBERT/Whisper audio pretraining [uncertain]
input_modality: audio-visual + text (multimodal: video frames, audio, subtitle/transcript text)
dynamic_fer_metrics: Evaluated on MER and EMER benchmarks rather than DFEW/FERV39k/MAFW; reports emotion-clue-overlap and reasoning-quality metrics specific to EMER [uncertain]
abaw_metrics: Not the target benchmark - not reported
cross_dataset_generalization: Demonstrates generalization across MER2023 and EMER; framework designed for open-vocabulary explainable emotion recognition
robustness: Robustness gained via multimodal fusion and language-based reasoning over audio + visual + text clues; quantitative occlusion/pose robustness not specifically reported [uncertain]
explainability: MLLM rationale support - core contribution is generating natural-language explanations / reasoning chains identifying multimodal emotional cues alongside predicted emotion labels (Explainable Multimodal Emotion Reasoning, EMER)
